Sanguinarios given special training for their loyalty, with unusual weapons and some chrome. Not as good as they think, but hard-hitting.

Valentinos: Heywood's Latino gang, all gold, faith and family.

Stat block from Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis, unofficial content under R. Talsorian Games' Homebrew Content Policy. Portrait: Neon Hub fan art of the Cyberpunk 2077 setting (CD PROJEKT RED), free to use, not for sale.

Required for all non-medical cyberware. Has a basic firewall (Chapter 10 of the Core Rules).
